message:
This week's giveaway is a bit different: we need YOUR help! Submit RuneScape trivia questions and get rewarded for it.

:pinkcutehearts: How it works:
Submit questions and earn tickets in the raffle (up to 5 entries, but feel free to submit more questions!)

Every question must include the correct answer. Submit it like this:

Single line:
Q: Who is the leader of Ascendants? A: Zweb

Multi-line:
Q: Who is the leader of Ascendants?
A: Zweb

Post the questions in ⁠:brain:│trivia-add. DogBot will reformat it and put it in ⁠:brain:│trivia-overview !

Keep them evergreen (no time-sensitive answers). Get creative! Go niche, dig into lore, obscure items, quest details, whatever you're into. Big into Slayer? Give us a good Slayer question. Love clue scrolls? Turn it into a clue!

:pinkcutehearts:Prize pool:
The more questions (that we approve), the higher the prize pool! The start of the prizepool is 200M.

Good luck!
